KernelStore in src/hermes_pipeline/persistence/kernel_store.py uses sqlite3 only. Schema: inbox(command_id PRIMARY KEY, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_json TEXT NOT NULL); events(event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, pipeline_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL); pipelines(pipeline_id PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL). submit opens one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction covering inbox+events+pipelines or rolls back completely.

CONFIRM_REQUIREMENT requires payload key text (str). REJECT_REQUIREMENT requires payload key reason (str). Missing/wrong type or unknown command_type -> REJECTED VALIDATION_ERROR message unsupported command, no durable write.

Load pipelines row or UNCONFIRMED revision 0 empty text. Call domain.apply. EMPTY_REQUIREMENT -> REJECTED VALIDATION_ERROR empty requirement. INVALID_TRANSITION -> REJECTED VALIDATION_ERROR invalid transition. ACCEPTED writes inbox, one event, updated pipelines row, returns ACCEPTED receipt with observed_revision = new revision and one event_id.

If inbox already has command_id: compare payload_hash of RFC 8785 canonical JSON of command.payload; equal -> return stored receipt (status DEDUPLICATED if originally accepted, or the stored status); unequal -> CONFLICT CONFLICT command identity conflict. If command.expected_revision != current pipelines.revision (missing row counts as 0) -> CONFLICT CONFLICT expected revision conflict before apply.
sqlite3.IntegrityError or OperationalError including disk full -> REJECTED INTERNAL_ERROR persistence unavailable retryable=true and no leftover partial rows (rollback).
